message:
Mike, you need to know that this website of yours is very valuable. I cannot thank you enough. If it were not for this website I would feel defeated by T-NETIX and MD DPSCS. I push on because of this site.

I'm sorry about the edgar on-line. I came across the site when I typed in 10-Q Quarterly Reports for the individual companies,Telequip Labs Inc, Evercom Inc  and Securus Technologies, Inc. When I find a better one that provides a link I will let you know.  When you read these things you will understand the things that they do to all of us. It does'nt have the money that Verizon and the other dominant carriers have and would soon be out of business.

I got a response from the Governor's office through the Office of the People's Council.
I was told that Celia Januszkiewicz of DBM would be interested in any comments regarding the service quality received, including issues with the customer service and billing departments.
I welcome this because it will give me an opportunity to mention this website and have all of you to send her comments about T-NETIX.

I have many issues with this company and that flyer. At the present they have blocked my other phone line. It has been blocked since August 2005.

I am not past due on anything so I don't understand it. The only thing I can think of is that I called them and told them to put me on their do not call list so that they would not keep calling me everytime I got a call from my Son.

Many, many thanks Mike.
